record.question: Which the correct statement about 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' in India.
options: It is the scheme to save the girl child
It is the Law that prohibit infanticide
It is the saving scheme for girl child
It is the scheme which for compulsory education for girl child
record.explanation: Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao is a government scheme to protect and empower the girl child, so option (a) is the correct statement; options (c) and (b) are less accurate.
